artists.biography:
One of the Future Sound Of London's most well-known aliases. Used for their early-1990's album Tales Of Ephidrina and their more recent releases The Isness (2002), Alice In Ultraland (2005) and The Peppermint Tree & The Seeds Of Superconsciousness (2008).

The liner notes for FSOL's album Lifeforms make mention of an Amorphous Androgynous album with a plain black cover called Environments, which after 14 years of mystery was finally released under the FSOL name.

perplexity.description:
A Monstrous Psychedelic Bubble (Exploding In Your Mind): The Wizards Of Oz is a 2015 compilation album curated and mixed by The Amorphous Androgynous, released on Festival Records and Monstrous Bubble Recordings. The album showcases a sprawling, genre-blurring journey that fuses electronic, rock, folk, world, and country influences, reflecting the duo’s signature approach to psychedelic soundscapes. Drawing from both classic and rare tracks, primarily from Australian artists, the album features extended mixes that weave together vintage psych-rock, ambient electronics, and global folk elements, creating a cosmic, immersive listening experience.

This release stands as a significant entry in The Amorphous Androgynous’ discography, continuing their tradition of genre-defying compilations and sonic experimentation. Unlike their earlier A Monstrous Psychedelic Bubble Exploding in Your Mind: Volume 1 (2008), which focused on international artists, The Wizards Of Oz highlights the rich and diverse psychedelic heritage of Australia. The album was praised for its ambitious scope and meticulous curation, with critics noting its ability to capture the spirit of psychedelic music across decades and styles. While not a commercial blockbuster, it was well-received by fans and critics for its depth, originality, and celebration of psychedelic music’s global reach.
